title: Jamaican Briny Bake
description: A unique combination of flavors and textures to cure that hangover. This Jamaican-inspired dish combines the brininess of feta cheese with the sweetness of caramelized onions and the crunch of fresh leaves.
instructions: In a large skillet, caramelize the onions over medium heat for 20 minutes.
In a separate pan, cook the sliced apples until they are tender.
In a large bowl, combine the crumbled feta cheese, caramelized onions, cooked apples, chopped leaves, honey, and jerk seasoning.
Mix well and transfer the mixture to a baking dish.
Drizzle the vine vinegar over the top of the mixture.
Bake for 20 minutes or until the top is golden brown.
